screens.title: Factory Home
screens.prompt:
Design the OGroup AI Factory Dashboard home as a premium enterprise AI control center. Desktop-first responsive, Arabic/English ready with RTL support. Answer three questions immediately: what is being built, is the Factory actually working, and does anything need the Product Owner. Include Build New Product, Active Projects, Running Jobs, Needs Attention, and Factory Health. Project rows show status, current stage, assigned worker, last activity, and required human action. Use evidence-based stages, never fake AI completion percentages. Clean minimal professional UI, not futuristic decoration.

REVISION REQUIREMENT: Preserve the approved structure and functionality, but make the interface genuinely Arabic/English bilingual and RTL-ready. Arabic must be visibly present throughout the primary UI content, navigation, labels, statuses, actions, cards, and decision surfaces, with at least 75% Arabic content coverage for Design Review. Keep English available as the secondary language. Do not remove Product Owner simplicity or existing functional content.

screens.title: Create Product
screens.prompt:
Design Create Product for OGroup AI Factory. Make product creation conversational and simple for a Product Owner, not an engineer. Main prompt: What do you want to build? Large idea textarea, upload documents/images/URLs, essential business constraints, and Start Factory. Hide advanced technical settings by default. Arabic/English ready and RTL. The experience should make it clear the Factory handles engineering orchestration after the idea.

screens.title: Project Control Room
screens.prompt:
Design the Project Control Room for OGroup AI Factory. Show measurable stages Idea, Product, Architecture, Design, Build, QA, Security, Staging, Review, Production. Prominently show current stage, current job, assigned agent/provider, start time, last heartbeat/activity, health, retries, and evidence such as files changed and tests. Technical logs stay behind View Engineering Details. Status model includes QUEUED, RUNNING, VERIFYING, RETRYING, WAITING_DEPENDENCY, WAITING_HUMAN, COMPLETED, FAILED, STALLED. Enterprise control center, RTL-ready.

screens.prompt:

Do not show routine repair noise, PR merge chores, or normal CI retries. Each item should explain why attention is required and provide one clear decision path. screens.prompt:
